tips.text: Bring a nuke frame with high range like Saryn, Volt, Mirage, Equinox or Gara, or the run stalls on efficiency.
Run public Sanctuary Onslaught; squads share affinity, so a nuker in the squad helps everyone.
Expect public squads to bail around zone 3 to 4; solo with a nuke frame if that keeps happening.
Start the Kavat Genetic Code scans early; they, not the mission, are the real bottleneck.
Players say the code gate annoys more than the mission, but nobody questions Khora being worth it.
